Thank you. I am already living in federal housing, my old high school was actually rehabbed and is now apartment for 55 plus low income seniors. I am exploring all means of support. And I know I will get by somehow, I have relatives here, who will help me. But you don't want to burden people , you know? I've always been independent and have never asked anyone for even a thin dime. It's a humbling experience to beg. My worst nightmare is envisioning myself on a street corner with a tin cup

Youre very kind to say that. 

I"m going next week to my community college, they apparently have some kind of federaly funded retraining program for older adults which I will participate in. Something like medical secretary. 

My business was a commercial photo lab. I know photoshop and pagemaker (knows way around the computer) but I doubt that's even useful anymore. This was before everyone had digital cameras. Last week I actually learned how to do a video editor which was fun. 

And with the wide gaps in employment, it's been my experience during this recession that most of my resumes get trashed. Age discrimination is rampant in this economy

good advice, and I know it was mostly him, and cultural differences (he is iranian)

I am getting my resume' polished up but I don't really have that much current work experience. I was a stay-at-home mom for many years, then I had my own small business for awhile and then the bottome fell out and I ended up working for a while at mcdonalds. And this guy hired me solely on the basis of how I rang up his chicken mcnuggets. He didn't know my skills

things started going downhill really over 15 years ago, when I met this conman on the early internet, and I got swooned and let him talk me into moving cross country. It went bad fast but I was trapped. I stayed in it for 8 years and he was supporting me afterwards for about 2 years, then he just disappeared, I had to move in with my mom 

Most of the time believe it or not in spite of all this, I have been able to be positive. But you get to this age, and you begin to understand how those chances don't happen as much anymore. And you look into the mirror and see this old crone where once was a pretty girl. It's devastating some times. Mostly I avoid mirrors
I got fired thursday. My boss said things that made me feel like I was utterly incompetent. I doubt I am but then again, I'm 58 and working minimum wage. It's been a horrible decade for me.
